<!-- Release: v0.11.1 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; updates the existing `.debug` app in place. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Add background scanning, scan-error details, and organized settings with shared list-view options
- Create playlists or review and import local M3U/M3U8 and PLS files from Library or Playlists
- Restore light browsing, full-width galleries, and lists beneath the floating controls
- Rework trailing drag-card motion and draw the stack above selection actions

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/33 - Scanner dialog, background scans, and structured settings
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/34 - Playlist creation and reviewed local-file import
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/35 - Metadata and embedded lyrics through granted file providers
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/36 - Smooth trailing drag cards and foreground stack layering
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/37 - List content under floating controls and mini-player artwork alignment
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/38 - Full-width galleries with long-press album menus
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/39 - Restored light browsing and readable text/icons

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.11.1-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Install over your existing development app to keep its data.

First use: **More → Scan music → Folders to scan**, then **Scan now**.
